en_title: Pocketpair Would Love to Release Palworld on Nintendo Switch 2, Despite Pokémon Legal Battle
cn_title: 《宝可梦》开发商盼《幻兽帕鲁》登任天堂新机
subtitle: 官司未了，意愿仍在
opus_summary: 《幻兽帕鲁》开发商表示，希望游戏能登陆Switch 2，但相关讨论仍须等待与任天堂的诉讼结束，也要看届时双方是否仍有芥蒂。日本法院计划于11月9日提出初步意见。

paragraphs.en: The legal battle between Nintendo and Pocketpair is ongoing, but the Palworld developer hasn’t ruled out a Switch 2 version of its creature collecting survival game.
paragraphs.cn: 任天堂与Pocketpair的官司仍在继续，但这家《幻兽帕鲁》开发商并未排除让这款生物收集生存游戏登陆Switch 2的可能。

paragraphs.en: Nintendo and The Pokémon Company are currently embroiled in ongoing litigation with Pocketpair in Japan, with patents that revolve around how Pokémon games work at the heart of the lawsuit. IP experts have indicated that Nintendo may only receive a $30,000 payout if it wins, but it's looking increasingly likely that Nintendo will lose.
paragraphs.cn: 任天堂和宝可梦公司目前仍在日本与Pocketpair打官司，诉讼的核心是涉及《宝可梦》游戏运行机制的专利。知识产权专家指出，即使任天堂胜诉，也可能只能获得30,000美元(约合人民币20万元)的赔偿，不过目前看来，任天堂败诉的可能性正变得越来越大。

paragraphs.en: Skirting around the elephant in the room in an interview with VGC , Pocketpair CEO Takuru Mizobe said he’d love to get Palworld on Switch 2. “Of course,” Mizobe replied when asked if the studio had Switch 2 ambitions. “First of all, I should say that we think the Switch 2 is a really amazing platform, not just for games globally, but especially here in Japan and for the Japanese games industry.
paragraphs.cn: 在接受VGC采访时，Pocketpair首席执行官Takuru Mizobe避开了这个无法忽视的问题，表示很希望让《幻兽帕鲁》登陆Switch 2。当被问及工作室是否有登陆Switch 2的打算时，他回答：「当然。首先我想说，我们认为Switch 2是一个非常出色的平台，不仅对全球游戏而言如此，对日本本土和日本游戏行业而言尤其如此。」

paragraphs.en: “It’s been an incredible platform. If there’s ever a future where we have the opportunity to discuss or consider bringing Palworld to the Switch platform in some way, then we’d love to have those conversations.”
paragraphs.cn: 「这个平台一直都很出色。如果未来有机会讨论或考虑以某种方式让《幻兽帕鲁》登陆Switch平台，我们会很乐意展开这些对话。」

paragraphs.en: Of course, the current legal dispute would have to play out before those conversations can happen, and that’s assuming there’s no bad blood once legal proceedings are done and dusted.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，这些对话得等当前的法律纠纷结束后才能展开，而且还得假设诉讼彻底结束后，双方之间没有留下芥蒂。

paragraphs.en: Nintendo filed a patent infringement lawsuit in September 2024, but the complaint was modified in November 2025 after Palworld updates changed some of the most egregious of the Pokemon-inspired game mechanics. One such mechanic was the ability to throw a sphere to summon a creature, which was removed in Early Access patch v0.3.11.
paragraphs.cn: 任天堂于2024年9月提起专利侵权诉讼。不过，《幻兽帕鲁》通过更新，修改了部分借鉴《宝可梦》痕迹最明显的游戏机制后，诉状于2025年11月作了修改。其中一项机制是投掷球体来召唤生物，这项机制已在抢先体验版v0.3.11补丁中移除。

paragraphs.en: Now when you summon a Pal, it simply spawns directly beside your character while you hold out the sphere. This change to avoid stepping on Nintendo’s patent removed some of the tactical options the player had, since they were no longer able to summon a Pal to a specific spot to draw aggro or hit an enemy from a different angle.
paragraphs.cn: 现在召唤帕鲁时，玩家角色会伸手举着球体，帕鲁则直接出现在角色身旁。为了避免侵犯任天堂的专利而作出的这项改动，让玩家少了一些战术选择：玩家无法再将帕鲁召唤到指定位置来吸引仇恨，或从另一个角度攻击敌人。

paragraphs.en: The scope of the lawsuit is reduced, but Pocketpair versus Nintendo and The Pokémon Company remains an active case within the Tokyo District Court. A preliminary view — which is a first-impression assessment of a subject before all the facts are known or a final decision is made — is planned for November 9 this year.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然诉讼范围有所缩小，但东京地方法院仍在审理Pocketpair与任天堂及宝可梦公司之间的这起案件。法院计划于今年11月9日提出初步意见，也就是在尚未掌握全部事实或作出最终裁决前，先对案件给出初步评估。

paragraphs.en: Palworld hit its 1.0 release in July , netting close to 1 million concurrent players on Steam. In total, Palworld has reached over 40 million players .
paragraphs.cn: 《幻兽帕鲁》于7月推出1.0正式版，Steam同时在线玩家数接近100万。游戏累计玩家数已超过4,000万。
